issue.detail: Spec says capture per bit when that bit falls; contract condition (prev_in & ~in) != 0 triggers capture of all falling bits simultaneously, which matches per-bit semantics, but alternative semantics could be 'capture only if any bit falls and then set all bits' vs 'set only falling bits'. Contract sets only falling bits via out |= prev_in & ~in implied by example? Example full fall cannot distinguish.
issue.spec_evidence: For each bit in a 32-bit vector, capture when the input signal changes from 1 in one clock cycle to 0 the next.
issue.alternative: On any falling edge of any bit, set all 32 output bits to 1 (global sticky) rather than per-bit sticky.
